Maya (Finance): Heads-up — Keystone Health flagged their Private renewal invoice: looks like the platform fee was billed twice because the new multi-year addendum overlapped the existing renewal line. Can someone confirm before I email them? :wave:
Liam (Accounting): Can you paste the invoice lines and invoice number? I can pull GL entries once I have that.
Maya (Finance): Invoice #INV-2026-3317. Key lines below:
```
INV-2026-3317
1 x PRIVATE_PLATFORM_FEE 2026-01-01 to 2027-01-01 $120,000
1 x PLATFORM_FEE_ADDENDUM_2026 2026-01-01 to 2027-01-01 $120,000
HARDWARE_RESERVE (prorated) $8,500
TAX (state passthrough) $11,300
TOTAL $259,800
```
Maya (Finance): Looks like both the base platform fee and the addendum fee were applied instead of the addendum replacing the base. Also the hardware reserve was applied even though the contract states it should be zero during the first year of the addendum.
Olga (Customer Success): Customer onboarding notes show they executed the addendum on 2026-01-02 (signed), renewal invoice dated 2026-01-05. Likely timing race between procurement and billing. They're upset about sticker shock.
Sam (Enterprise Sales): Confirming contract: the addendum (A-KE-2026-MYA) explicitly supersedes base platform fee for Year 1 and shifts to a step-down schedule in Year 2. I can attach the PDF. We should credit the duplicate platform fee and remove the hardware reserve charge.
Ben (Ops): For credits we should avoid reopening the original invoice to prevent payment reconciliation churn. Recommend issuing a separate credit memo referencing INV-2026-3317 and a corrected pro-forma if they need it for their AP.
Liam (Accounting): Agreed. I need the contract clause and the GL codes to post the credit. Maya, can you confirm amount to credit? Is it full $120k + $8.5k reserve + proportional tax?
Maya (Finance): Requesting approval to credit platform fee $120,000 + hardware reserve $8,500 + tax delta ~ $6,600 (estimate) total credit ~$135,100. If approved I'll generate the credit memo and route for sign-off.
Sam (Enterprise Sales): Approve the credit up to $140k to handle any rounding and local tax adjustments. :white_check_mark: We should also add a one-paragraph explanation to the credit memo referencing the addendum execution date.
Liam (Accounting): I'll prepare the journal entry mapping: Credit to revenue (PLAT-FEE-REV) and debit to AR. Need the customer PO number to reference.
Olga (Customer Success): Customer PO is PO-77899, attached in the onboarding folder. I'll draft the customer-facing note: short apology + clear statement of correction + timing for refund/credit application.
Maya (Finance): Thanks — I'll create billing ticket and draft the credit memo. billing-bot, please create a formal ticket for this work.
billing-bot: Created ticket B-4521: "Keystone Health duplicate platform fee & hardware reserve — credit memo request". Owner: Maya (Finance). SLA: 5 business days.
Ben (Ops): FYI, let's add a short-run automation to block simultaneous renewal/addendum invoices for the same account when signing dates are within 7 days; this has come up twice this quarter. I'll open an infra ticket.
Maya (Finance): Noted — I'll include a follow-up action in B-4521 to coordinate with Ops.
Liam (Accounting): Once credit memo is posted, I will send the GL details and closing entry. ETA to post credit: 48 hours after approval.
Olga (Customer Success): I'll send the external note as soon as the credit memo number is available. Customer wants confirmation before EOD Friday.
Maya (Finance): Understood — I'll prioritize. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
